tasks.title: B418 root-cause
tasks.brief: apps/api/src/common/prod-migrate-script.spec.ts, run() (line 43-50) calls spawnSync(process.execPath, [SCRIPT], {timeout:30_000,...}); line 148 asserts `expect(res.status).toBe(2)` on a real (DB-free, port-1-target) invocation of scripts/prod-migrate.mjs. Node's own spawnSync contract: when `timeout` fires, the child is killed and `status` comes back null, not the real exit code -- under severe host contention this specific real invocation can exceed 30s and flip a correct run into `status:null`, indistinguishable from a real wrong value. Probe: write a throwaway script (NOT the real prod-migrate.mjs) that never exits (e.g. `setInterval(()=>{},1000)`), spawnSync it with the identical {timeout:30_000} option, and confirm status comes back null and signal is set -- this deterministically reproduces Node's own timeout-kill contract, independent of host speed. Do not touch the real script or the test file.
